chestEase.name: Chest ease (%)
chestEase.help: The amount of ease at your chest.

draftForHighBust.name: Draft for high bust
draftForHighBust.help: Draft the pattern using the high bust measurement if it is available, instead of using the chest measurement. This can result in a more fitted garment for people with breasts. (Please note that no additional adjustments or shaping is performed. Further manual adjustments may be needed for those with a larger difference between high bust and chest measurements.)

hipsEase.name: Hips ease (%)
hipsEase.help: The amount of ease at your hips.

lengthBonus.name: Length bonus (%)
lengthBonus.help: The amount to lengthen the garment. A negative value will shorten it.

armholeDrop.name: Armhole drop (%)
armholeDrop.help: Lower the armhole by this amount. Negative values will raise it.

necklineBend.name: Neckline shape (%)
necklineBend.help: Determines the shape/bend of the neckline at the front.

necklineDrop.name: Neckline drop (%)
necklineDrop.help: The amount the neck is cutout at the front.

shoulderStrapWidth.name: Shoulderstrap width (%)
shoulderStrapWidth.help: The width of the shoulder straps.

shoulderStrapPlacement.name: Shoulderstrap placement (%)
shoulderStrapPlacement.help: Determines whether the shoulder strap is placed closer to the neck (lower numbers) or the shoulder (higher numbers).

backlineBend.name: Back armhole shape (%)
backlineBend.help: Determines the shape/bend of the back of the armholes.

knitBindingWidth.name: Knit binding width (%)
knitBindingWidth.help: Controls the width of the knit binding as a percentage of the chosen seam allowance, or 1cm if no seam allowance is used.

armholeDepth.name: Armhole depth (%)
armholeDepth.help: Controls the depth of the armhole. Higher values make a deeper armhole.

legacyArmholeDepth.name: Legacy armhole depth
legacyArmholeDepth.help: Enable this option to use the legacy way to calculate the armhole depth (using biceps circumference) rather than the v3 way (using the waist to armpit measurement)
